description: This file defines the Hex class, which provides methods for encoding and decoding hexadecimal strings and byte arrays, including handling ByteBuffer objects. It implements thread-safe conversion utilities for hexadecimal data, with configurable character encoding.

classes.name: Hex
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding byte arrays to hexadecimal strings and decoding hexadecimal strings to byte arrays, with support for different character encodings and ByteBuffer handling.

methods.name: decodeHex
methods.description: Decodes a character array or string of hexadecimal digits into a byte array.

methods.name: encodeHex
methods.description: Encodes a byte array or ByteBuffer into a hexadecimal character array or string.

methods.name: toDigit
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal character to its integer value.

methods.name: getCharset
methods.description: Returns the Charset used for encoding/decoding.

methods.name: getCharsetName
methods.description: Returns the name of the Charset used.
